body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M\) and \(a\in I\), the ADRF is point identified by \(\mu(a)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}p_xq_x(a)/f_x(a)\), where every term on the right is a functional of \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\).
body.justification: This connects the analytic marked transform to the causal dose-response curve.
body.gap: Huang and Zhang identify this target under a known everywhere-nonzero error transform, not under blind asymmetric replicates with spectral gaps.
body.consumer: The formula is the population target for a simultaneous uncertainty display over the scientifically relevant dose interval.
